verdict.rationale: Docs show 40+ documented alert sources plus custom HTTP sources, alert grouping/deduplication, and escalation paths with rules based on priority/working hours to route to the right on-call team/schedule — directly matching the story's ingestion+condition-based routing requirement. Integration directory further corroborates specific monitoring tool sources (Datadog, Grafana, Honeycomb, New Relic, PagerDuty, Sentry). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of routing-condition configuration in practice and more detail on custom condition/team-assignment logic beyond changelog snippets.
